a.text: Pavel Stepanovich Nakhimov's command during the Siege of Sevastopol ended.

b.text: Pavel Nakhimov received the Order of the White Eagle for actions in the defence of Sevastopol.

a.text: The Soviet government established the Order of Nakhimov with two degrees.

b.text: The Soviet government established the Nakhimov Medal for Navy personnel.

a.text: Pavel Nakhimov received the Order of St. Vladimir, 2nd class for the successful transfer of 13th Division.

b.text: Pavel Nakhimov received the Order of Saint George, 2nd class for the victory at Sinope.
